description: D4 mode-matrix — preset P6 (cycle:discovery, window [3→4]) under M2 (checkpoint-gated). Runner auto-traverses analysis-discovery, then halts at HUMAN_CHECKPOINT post-analysis before advancing to specification. Resumes only when injected decision token [HIMA_DECISION:approved] appears in turn 2. Models GOAL-3 §4c M2: 'auto through analysis; HUMAN_CHECKPOINT before spec; resume → stop'.

turns.text: Activate cycle:discovery:gate. Run analysis-discovery automatically. Then halt at HUMAN_CHECKPOINT — do not proceed to specification until a decision token is injected.
[HIMA_DECISION:approved] Continue to specification. Produce the full spec artifact. This is the window stop.

d4.contract: Auto through stage 3 (analysis-discovery); halt at HUMAN_CHECKPOINT post-analysis; resume on injected decision token; then complete specification and stop
d4.ref: GOAL-3.md §4b P6 window [3→4]; §4c M2 row; GOAL-3.md §5 D4 'M2 halts at HUMAN_CHECKPOINT post-analysis, resumes on injected decision'
